MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this GNSS Object.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this GNSS Object.

GNSSObjectID.description: Unique identifier of this GNSS Object instance.

GNSSData.description: GNSS Data from a Global Navigation Satellite System receiver.

DataURI.description: URI reference to the GNSS Data.

GNSSDataQualifier.description: Qualifier providing information on Sub-Types, Formats, and Attributes of GNSS Data.
